column1: 22659§estimate§ˈestɪmeɪt§The deal is estimated to be worth around £1.5 million.§这笔交易**估计**价值150万英镑左右。§

22660§livelihood§ˈlaɪvlihʊd§We understand a port as a centre of land-sea exchange, and as a major source of livelihood and a major force for cultural mixing.§我们把港口理解为一个海陆交流的中心，**生活**的重要资源，文化融合的主要推动力量。§
22661§manufacture§ˌmænjuˈfæktʃə(r)§Many automobile makers no longer manufacture cheap models.§很多汽车制造商不再**大量生产**低价位车型。§
22662§censure§ˈsenʃə(r)§The warden censured the guard for letting the prisoner escape.§监狱长**责骂**狱警让罪犯逃走了。§
22663§voltage§ˈvəʊltɪdʒ§The voltage made her hair shoot straight out.§**电压**使得她的头发竖了起来。§
22664§logic§ˈlɒdʒɪk§Miranda holds the belief that science and logic will unlock the mysteries of the plague.§米兰达坚信科学和**逻辑**会解开这场瘟疫的未解之谜。§
22665§enroll§ɪnˈrəʊl§Places are available here even for students enrolled in the minimum length course.§这里甚至为那些**报名**参加最短课时的学生提供上课场所。§
22666§civilization§ˌsɪvəlaɪˈzeɪʃn§Many important civilizations developed from Asia.§许多重要的**文明**发源于亚洲。§
22667§compendium§kəmˈpendiəm§The human genome is the compendium of all these inherited genetic instructions.§人类基因组是所有这些遗传基因说明的一个**缩影**。§
22668§embark§ɪmˈbɑːk§Without hesitation Alexander embarked on his new career as a musician.§亚历山大毫不犹豫地**开始**了他的新职业，成为一名音乐家。§
22669§deserve§dɪˈzɜːv§These poor people deserve our help.§这些可怜的人**值得**我们帮助。§
22670§eject§ɪˈdʒekt§The quantity of dust ejected by Mount St. Helens amounted to a quarter of a cubic mile.§圣海伦斯火山**喷出**的粉尘多达四分之一立方英里。§

22671§verification§ˌverɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§The customs will make a verification of whether there is record filing before the goods are released.§在货物放行之前，海关会先**确认**一下该批货物是否有备案。§改例句：make a verification 后接 whether 从句缺介词，补 of；release 是及物动词，the goods release 改为被动 the goods are released

22672§autoimmune§ˌɔːtəʊɪˈmjuːn§Once this immune tolerance breaks down, the immune system would attack its own tissue, and cause autoimmune diseases.§一旦这种免疫耐受受到损害，免疫系统就会攻击自身的组织，引发**自身免疫**疾病。§改例句：主语 tolerance 是第三人称单数，break 改为 breaks

22673§inheritance§ɪnˈherɪtəns§To get rid of being called "NEET Group", he is too stubborn to accept the inheritance from his father.§为了摆脱“啃老族”的称号，他固执地拒绝接受父亲的**遗产**。§改例句：inheri- tance 是排版断行残留，应为 inheritance；中文引号改为英文引号
22674§relentless§rɪˈlentləs§Relentless in his pursuit of quality, his technical ability was remarkable.§由于对质量的**坚持不懈**的追求，他的技术能力非同凡响。§
22675§requisite§ˈrekwɪzɪt§The keyboard is a requisite hardware device of a computer, also a dialogue tool between a man and a computer.§键盘是计算机**必要**的硬件设备，也是人与计算机对话的工具。§
22676§dizziness§ˈdɪzinəs§With a sudden dizziness, he fell down on the floor, which frightened his family.§突然一阵**眩晕**，他跌倒在地上，把他的家人吓坏了。§改例句：fall down 后接地点要用介词，补 on
22677§periphery§pəˈrɪfəri§Ideas on this matter are also expressed by some scholars on the periphery of education area.§教育领域**外围**的一些学者也对此发表了看法。§改译文：原译「领域外」括不出 periphery（外围），改为「领域外围」
22678§credential§krəˈdenʃl§Refused by the enterprise again, she was so upset that she tore up these credential documents by hand.§再次被企业拒之门外，她极其沮丧，随手将这些**资格证书**撕了个粉碎。§
22679§facsimile§fækˈsɪməli§The painting is a facsimile edition that is not so valuable.§这幅画是**复制品**，不是很值钱。§
22680§reel§riːl§There are another three new reels of film for use.§还有三**卷**新胶卷可以使用。§
22681§churn§tʃɜːn§The butter churn has two paddles to whip the cream.§黄油**搅乳器**有两根搅棍用来搅打奶油。§改例句：主语 churn 是第三人称单数，have 改为 has
22682§nocturnal§nɒkˈtɜːnl§It is probable that the nocturnal traits go way back in the ancestry of all mammals.§**夜间**进行活动可能是所有哺乳动物自祖先时起就有的行为。§改例句：拼写错，trades（交易）应为 traits（特征）

22683§obstruct§əbˈstrʌkt§Fish and dolphins that live in extremely muddy water cannot see because, although there is light, it is obstructed and scattered by the dirt in the water.§生活在极其浑浊的水域里的鱼和海豚是看不见东西的，因为尽管有光，但水里的污垢**阻塞**和分散了光线。§
22684§prohibitive§prəˈhɪbətɪv§This doesn't require a prohibitive amount of energy.§这并不要求具有**过高**的能量。§改译文：原译「强大」不是 prohibitive（高得令人却步的）的意思，改为「过高」

22685§navigation§ˌnævɪˈgeɪʃn§All the world now knows that bats, or rather natural selection working on bats, had perfected the system tens of millions of years earlier, and their radar achieves feats of detection and navigation that would strike an engineer dumb with admiration.§现在人们意识到，确切地说因为自然选择的作用，蝙蝠早在几千万年前就已经完善了它们的雷达系统，其在探测与**导航**方面的成功让工程师们赞叹不已。§
22686§entwine§ɪnˈtwaɪn§The history of human civilization is entwined with the history of the ways we have learned to manipulate water resources.§人类文明的历史与人类学习利用水资源的历程是**相互交织**在一起的。§

22687§monumental§ˌmɒnjuˈmentl§Unprecedented construction of tens of thousands of monumental engineering projects has been done to control floods in the country.§该国史无前例地建造了成千上万的**重要**工程来控制水患。§改例句：主语 construction 是单数，have 改为 has

22688§reiterate§riˈɪtəreɪt§As the United Nations report on access to water reiterated in November 2001, more than one billion people lack access to clean drinking water.§2001年11月联合国关于获取水资源的报告**重申**了一个事实，即10亿多人口无法获取纯净的饮用水。§
22689§peripheral§pəˈrɪfərəl§If we think of a book we studied months or years ago, we will find it easier to recall peripheral details.§当我们回想几个月或几年前读过的一本书时，我们更容易记起一些**细枝末节**。§
22690§jeopardise§ˈdʒepədaɪz§He has never done anything to jeopardise his family.§他从来没有做过任何**伤害**其家庭的事情。§

22691§elusive§ɪˈluːsɪv§Even if these peripheral details are a bit elusive, they come back readily in hypnosis or when we relive the event imaginatively, as in psychodrama.§即使这些细枝末节有点**容易忘却**，但它们也会在我们处于催眠状态下或者重温往事时在脑海里生动地浮现出来，就像在心理剧里那样。§

22692§distinctive§dɪˈstɪŋktɪv§If you require any further information regarding the convention, you can talk to one of the many convention helpers wearing distinctive blue and gold jackets.§如果你想获得更多关于本次会议的信息，可以询问大会工作人员，他们穿着**显眼**的金蓝相间的夹克。§改例句：复数 jackets 前不能用 a，删去 a
22693§board§bɔːd§All ceilings will require double-thickness plaster board to be used in the construction.§在建造过程中，所有天花板都需要使用双层厚的灰泥**板**。§

22694§decompression§ˌdiːkəmˈpreʃn§A manifestation of decompression sickness that is caused by the formation of nitrogen bubbles in the blood and tissues after a rapid reduction in the surrounding pressure is characterized by pain in the joints and abdomen.§**减压**病是因周围压力急剧减少，在血液和组织中形成氮气泡而引发的一种疾病，其症状表现为关节和腹部疼痛。§

22695§prevalent§ˈprevələnt§It's no surprise that high-profile athletes can influence children's eating behaviours, but the scientists are able to quantify how prevalent these endorsements are in the children's environment.§高知名度的运动员可以影响儿童的饮食行为，这并不奇怪，但科学家能够量化这些代言在儿童环境中的**流行**程度。§
22696§twist§twɪst§Research shows that spasms can cause twisting of the spine.§研究显示，痉挛会导致脊椎**扭曲**。§
22697§rent§rent§This house rents for RMB 5,000 a month.§这房子月**租**5,000人民币。§
22698§eminent§ˈemɪnənt§He was then the most eminent architect in England.§他是当时英格兰最**著名**的建筑师。§
22699§crescent§ˈkresnt§The crescent of a new moon hung over the mulberry in the yard.§一**弯**新月高悬于院子里的桑树之上。§
22700§calm§kɑːm§The pilot managed to bring the aircraft and its 50 passengers down safely in the calm waters of the bay.§飞行员成功地将飞机降落在**风平浪静**的海湾中，确保了50名乘客的安全。§
22701§scope§skəʊp§The scope of the environmental problem facing the world's cities is immense.§世界上的许多城市面临着大**范围**的环境问题。§
22702§cooperate§kəʊˈɒpəreɪt§It is meaningful for world nations to cooperate with each other.§对世界各国来说，相互**合作**的意义重大。§
22703§applaud§əˈplɔːd§They applaud their favorite comedienne as she comes on the stage.§当他们最喜欢的女喜剧演员登台时，他们**鼓掌**欢迎。§
22704§appraisal§əˈpreɪzl§Susan's appraisal of the writer's work was favorable.§苏珊对这位作家的作品给予了肯定的**评价**。§
22705§allowance§əˈlaʊəns§I have a good retirement allowance that will make it easy for me to buy a nice house.§我有一笔丰厚的退休**金**，买一栋好房子没什么经济上的困难。§
22706§heir§eə(r)§The man murdered the legal heir and disguised himself as his victim.§该男子谋杀了合法**继承人**并冒名顶替。§改例句：disguise oneself 后接身份要用 as，补 as
22707§exploit§ɪkˈsplɔɪt§Our company was quick to exploit a money-making opportunity provided by the government.§我们公司很快就**抓住**了政府提供的赚钱机会。§
22708§domestic§dəˈmestɪk§The evidence we have suggests that domestic trade was greater than external trade at all periods.§我们掌握的证据表明，无论在哪个时期，**国内**贸易都要比对外贸易发达。§
22709§unexpected§ˌʌnɪkˈspektɪd§Some unexpected difficulties have arisen in his life.§他的生活中出现了一些**意想不到**的困难。§
22710§counsel§ˈkaʊnsl§Today's Health Counsel is presented by Paula Clayburg.§今天的健康**忠告**由波拉·克莱伯格讲解。§
22711§sticky§ˈstɪki§My fingers are sticky from that candy bar.§糖块把我的手指弄得**黏糊糊**的。§
22712§competition§ˌkɒmpəˈtɪʃn§The workers opened small businesses in direct competition with their former employer.§工人们开办了小型公司，直接和他们以前的雇主**竞争**。§
22713§responsible§rɪˈspɒnsəbl§Smoking, as it is believed, is responsible for 30 percent of all deaths from cancer.§在因癌症导致的死亡中，有30%被认为是由吸烟**引起**的。§
22714§critic§ˈkrɪtɪk§The coal industry has been targeted by critics as a significant contributor to the greenhouse effect.§煤炭业被**评论家**指责为造成温室效应的主要原因。§
22715§extensive§ɪkˈstensɪv§Extensive underground water resources are available over more than half of Australia's land area.§在澳大利亚，超过一半的地域中**广泛**分布着可利用的地下水资源。§
22716§corridor§ˈkɒrɪdɔː(r)§You will notice that at the end of each corridor there is another door, but these are fire doors.§你会注意到在每一条**走廊**的尽头都有另一扇门，但这些是防火门。§
22717§imagine§ɪˈmædʒɪn§The children have no need to imagine anything when they read such books.§孩子们阅读这种书时根本不用发挥**想象**力。§
22718§interact§ˌɪntərˈækt§Group work can give employees a chance to interact and to share ideas.§分组工作可以给员工一个**相互协作**和交流的机会。§
22719§starchy§ˈstɑːtʃi§You eat too much starchy food.§你吃太多**含淀粉**的食物了。§
22720§trivial§ˈtrɪviəl§They think that tourism is a trivial subject.§他们认为旅行是一个**无关紧要**的主题。§
22721§exorbitant§ɪɡˈzɔːbɪtənt§Glass as instant curtains is available now, but the cost is exorbitant.§现在玻璃可作为即时窗帘用，但成本**过于昂贵**。§
22722§large-scale§ˌlɑːdʒ ˈskeɪl§They invested much money into large-scale industrial development.§他们投入大量金钱发展**大规模**的工业。§
22723§region§ˈriːdʒən§Although the UK is a fairly small country, the geology and climate vary a good deal from region to region.§尽管英国的国土面积很小，但是不同**地区**间的地况和气候却大相径庭。§
22724§alternate§ˈɔːltəneɪt§Snow and rain alternated, and it was very cold outside.§外面雨雪**交加**，非常寒冷。§
22725§steer§stɪə(r)§He steered his car very carefully along the narrow mountain roads.§他非常小心地**驾**车行驶在狭窄的山路上。§
22726§bargain§ˈbɑːgən§The employees and the employer reached a bargain.§雇员和老板达成了一项**协议**。§
22727§infection§ɪnˈfekʃn§Are you taking oral medicines for fungal infections?§你在吃口服药预防真菌**感染**吗？§
22728§conservative§kənˈsɜːvətɪv§The obstacle to our development has been conservative local authorities.§**保守**的地方当局一直是我们发展的障碍。§
22729§spin§spɪn§This action spins a series of gears.§这个操作使一连串的齿轮**旋转**起来。§
22730§personnel§ˌpɜːsəˈnel§All personnel were asked to participate in the meeting.§此次会议要求全体**员工**参加。§
22731§liver§ˈlɪvə(r)§Some scientists think that the condition of your liver determines how the perfume will smell on you.§一些科学家认为，人体**肝脏**的健康状况决定了香水在人身上的味道。§
22732§swear§sweə(r)§Before giving evidence, you must swear what you're going to say is true.§作证前，你必须**宣誓**保证所说一切皆属实。§

22733§inflammable§ɪnˈflæməbl§Impressed by the element's combustibility, several 17th century chemists used it to manufacture fire-lighting devices, but the results were dangerously inflammable.§受这种元素可燃性的启发，17世纪的一些化学家用它来制造点火装置，但这些装置却**易燃**，十分危险。§改译文：原译「容易发生危险性的燃烧」括不出 inflammable（易燃的），改为「却易燃，十分危险」
22734§disfigure§dɪsˈfɪɡə(r)§Buildings here disfigured such a beautiful landscape.§这里的建筑**破坏**了如此美丽的风景。§
22735§surf§sɜːf§The rugged west coast beaches were famous for surfing.§蜿蜒曲折的西海岸海滩因适合**冲浪**而闻名。§
